justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/Functions.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/FunctionsTest.java. The nested interface has only one method (`accept`) and is only used by two wrapper methods in the same class (`Functions.accept(...)` and `Functions.asBiConsumer(...)`), so its fan-out is very small. A repository search found no production-code references to `Functions.FailableBiConsumer`; the only external references are in `FunctionsTest.java` (one import and two anonymous test implementations), which shows very low fan-in. This does not match hub-like modularization.
